html:
Perks › Common

Low Rider

Common perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, a bone with 3 total pips or fewer adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

When your scoring play uses a bone with 3 pips or fewer in total (0-0, 0-1, 0-2, 0-3, 1-1 and 1-2), the play gains +5 points for each copy.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
